text:
Response B is more accurate and better meets the brief. Its figures check out, including the $21,600 hire-car estimate (2 months × $1,800 × 6 cars), and it covers the recommendation, the budget overrun, the approval requirement, the alternative and the 24 October deadline. It is at or very near the 120-word limit.

Response A runs well over 120 words. It also contains an error: it says Coastal Fleet Sales is more expensive than the options above, but Coastal's petrol price ($36,100) is below the Elmwood hybrid ($38,190). Its opening line is also awkwardly phrased as if written by Dominic. Its extra detail (the Coastal note, the fuller bullet structure) does not add enough to justify the length.

Verdict: B
